ASSURANCE / RENDERED LAYOUT

Measured, still discerned.

The algebra compares real browser rectangles, heading relationships and document dimensions at desktop and mobile widths. Aberrations are preserved for review.

All assurance topics · Navigation source checks · Raw observations and findings

Evidence and its limits

Desktop: 1280 × 800. Mobile width: 390 × 844. The recorded routes were loaded with their scripts, styles and content at capture time. Currentness metadata identifies stale or missing coverage. The initial loaded state is measured; this does not certify other engines, physical devices, interactive states or the purpose of whitespace.

A difference in alignment or a large gap is observable. Whether it is unnecessary remains a review decision. The audit never repairs a page automatically.
